title: Kestrel Robotics annual filing (10-K excerpt) for FY2025
text: Item 7. Results of operations. After completion of the audit, Kestrel Robotics recognised an adjustment to multi-year service contracts. Kestrel Robotics reported FY2025 revenue of $412M, up 18% year over year (restated after the audit adjustment; supersedes the February preliminary release). Subscription revenue represented 38% of the total.
